text: MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF SCHOLARSHIPS FOR COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY STUDENTS 1. OBJECTIVE: To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections for meeting a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in recognized colleges and universities. 2. SCHOLARSHIP ALLOCATION & QUOTA: - Total number of fresh scholarships per year: 82,000 (41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls). - Allocation among State Education Boards is based on the state's population in the 18-25 age group. - Board-wise quota divided among Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams in the ratio of 3:2:1. 3. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS: - Students who are above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from a recognized Board of Examination in Class XII. - Pursuing regular courses (not correspondence or distance mode) in recognized Higher Educational Institutions. - Family income from all sources must NOT exceed Rs 4.50 lakh per annum. - Not receiving any other central/state scholarship or fee reimbursement.

CENTRAL SECTOR SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (Page 2) 4. RATE OF SCHOLARSHIP: - Graduation Level: Rs 12,000/- per annum for the first three years of undergraduate study. - Post-Graduation Level: Rs 20,000/- per annum for the 4th and 5th year (for 2-year Master's degree or 4th/5th year of 5-year integrated courses). - For technical courses like B.Tech/B.E., the rate is Rs 12,000/- per year for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year, and Rs 20,000/- per year in the 4th year. 5. RENEWAL CRITERIA: - Minimum 50% marks in the annual examination. - Minimum 75% attendance during the academic year. - Maintenance of good discipline and conduct.

MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT POST MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR SCHEDULED CASTE STUDENTS (PMS-SC) 1. OBJECTIVE: To appreciably increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) of SC students in higher education with a focus on the poorest households, by providing financial support at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages. 2. SCOPE & ELIGIBILITY: - Applicable for study of all recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses pursued in recognized institutions. - Scholarships are paid only to candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC). - Total family income from all sources should not exceed Rs 2.50 lakh per annum. - All children of the same parents/guardian are eligible for the scholarship without cap on number of siblings. 3. COMPONENTS OF SCHOLARSHIP: The scholarship covers: a) Compulsory non-refundable fees payable to the institution (tuition fee, registration fee, library, sports, exam fees). b) Academic Allowance (Maintenance allowance) based on course category.

ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE) PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR GIRL STUDENTS (DEGREE & DIPLOMA) 1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE: Pragati is an AICTE Scheme envisioned to promote technical education and empower young women by providing financial assistance to pursue advancement in technical degrees and diplomas. 2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: - The girl student should be admitted to the First year of Degree/Diploma level course OR Second year of Degree/Diploma course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions. - Maximum two girl children per family are eligible. - Family income from all sources should not exceed Rs 8.00 lakh per annum during the preceding financial year. - Valid income certificate issued by competent State authority required. 3. NUMBER OF SCHOLARSHIPS: - 10,000 scholarships per annum (5,000 for Degree + 5,000 for Diploma). - All eligible girl students from 13 Union Territories/North Eastern states receive scholarship without merit-cutoff restrictions.

AICTE PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP (Page 2) 4. SCHOLARSHIP AMOUNT & DISBURSEMENT: - Rs 50,000/- per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma). - Amount is provided as lump-sum college fee payment, computer purchase, stationery, books, and equipment. - No separate hostel or mess allowance is payable under this scheme. 5. RENEWAL: The scholarship renewal is subject to passing each academic year and maintaining good academic progression. No dropouts or year-backs permitted for renewal benefit.
